text:
Nora: Morning — copy sprint: need final hero + micro-metric + webinar CTA + routing payload for Hosted API / Redwood Dedicated / Private (VPC & on-prem). Launch next Thu. 9:30 review — who can make it?
Vik: I can. Will bring p95/p50 snippets and a short bench blurb. Keep micro-metrics tight.
Janel: Posting 3 hero options per mode in 15m. Developer-first, minimal jargon.
Ed: Legal note: use exact product labels; use "customer-managed keys (CMK)" and "audit trail". Avoid the word "pricing" in hero copy. Replace "audit logs" -> "audit trail".
FormsBot: Form created: https://forms.example/launch-jul-2026 — fields: email,name,company,employees,deployment_interest,utm_campaign. Webhook draft ready.
Nora: Good — please include one-line bench under each hero (p95 or tokens/min). Vik will confirm canonical strings. CTA must be short (2–4 words) + one microline.
Janel: Draft heroes and subheads: 
Hosted H1: "Hosted API — launch features without infra ops"
Hosted H2: "Hosted API — API-first inference, ready for production"
Hosted H3: "Hosted API — low-latency text, chat, embeddings"
Subhead (Hosted): "p95 ~140ms (chat, 8k) • streaming & usage metrics"

Dedicated D1: "Redwood Dedicated — reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput"
D2: "Redwood Dedicated — SLA-backed performance; pin models"
D3: "Redwood Dedicated — consistent latency for customer-facing apps"
Subhead (Dedicated): "Sustained 20–30k tokens/min per pool • canary rollouts"

Private P1: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — run our runtime inside your perimeter"
P2: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — CMK, audit trail, and on-prem options"
P3: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — enterprise control over inference"
Subhead (Private): "Same runtime, behind your network — HSM/KMS integrations"

Janel: CTA options: "Save my seat — live benchmark" / "Join demo: perf & rollout" / "See it live". Microline: "Includes benchmark walkthrough + 15-min office hours".
Vik: For Hosted use lab canonical: "p95 135ms (chat, 8k)". Dedicated: "sustained 22–28k tokens/min per pool". No $ figures on public pages.
Nora: Routing rules for webinar leads: bucket by employees -> {>=5000: enterprise, 1000–4999: strategic-AE, <1000: growth}. Always include deployment_interest. If deployment_interest=="Private" and employees>=1000 -> route to enterprise with priority=true.
Janel: Sample webhook payload for forms team to wire:
```
{
  "email": "lead@startup.io",
  "name": "Case Lead",
  "company": "Startup.io",
  "employees": 1200,
  "deployment_interest": "Private",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-jul-2026"
}
```
Nora: Perfect. Action items: Janel finalize Hosted H2, Dedicated D2, Private P2; Vik to post bench doc links and canonical strings; Ed to confirm CMK/HSM phrasing; Forms to wire webhook and set tags: deployment_interest and size_bucket. 9:30 review confirmers: @Vik @Janel @Ed.
Vik: I'll drop bench links at 8:50 and add a short trust line under hero: "Benchmarks from production-like workloads" linking to docs.
Ed: Legal approves CMK/audit trail phrasing — no "pricing" on hero. Approved.
FormsBot: Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.example/webinar-launch — mapped fields: email,name,company,employees,deployment_interest,utm_campaign.
Nora: Great. If we lock copy + CTA today we can push to staging and enable the hero CTA. Thanks team :rocket:
Janel: Posting final mock in #design in 20m.
Vik: See you at review.
Ed: ✅
